data.name: Asifa
data.gender_notes: Asifa is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is protected by Allah. The name Asifa carries the meaning “Protected” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu. Parents who choose Asifa usually hope their child will grow to embody protected and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name given to those who are under the protection and care of Allah
data.etymology: Asifa belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Protected.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Asifa total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_arabic.name: عاصفة
in_arabic.meaning: عاصفة تعني المرأة التي تتولى أمورها بجد ونشاط
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم عاصفة مشتق من الجذر العربي 'ع-ص-ف' والذي يعني الحركة السريعة أو النشاط. في اللغة العربية، عاصفة تعني المرأة التي تتولى أمورها بجد ونشاط، وتتميز بالحزم والجدية في إدارة شؤونها. كما يمكن أن يرتبط بالعاصفة في الطبيعة، مما يوحي بالقوة والطاقة.

in_urdu.name: عاصفہ
in_urdu.meaning: عاصفہ یعنی وہ خاتون جو اپنی زندگی کے امور کو بڑی جدت و سرگرمی سے چلاتی ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: عاصفہ نام کی اصیل عربی جڑ 'ع-ص-ف' سے بناہوا ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے سرعت یا سرگرمی۔ اردو میں، عاصفہ کا نام اس عورت کے لئے استعمال ہوتا ہے جو اپنی زندگی کے مختلف پہلوؤں کو انتہائی جدت و سرگرمی اور حزم کے ساتھ سنبھالتی ہے۔ یہ نام عربی ثقافت میں طاقت، سرگرمی اور جدت کی علامت کے طور پر استعمال ہوتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: आसिफा
in_hindi.meaning: आसिफा यानी वह महिला जो अपनी जिंदगी के मामलों को बहुत सजगता और क्रियाशीलता से चलाती है
in_hindi.long_meaning: आसिफा नाम की जड़ अربی भाषा में 'ع-ص-ف' से है, जिसका अर्थ है गति या क्रियाशीलता। हिंदी में, आसिफा नाम उस महिला के लिए प्रयोग किया जाता है जो अपनी जिंदगी के विभिन्न पहलुओं को बहुत सजगता, क्रियाशीलता और गहनता से संचालित करती है। यह नाम अरबी संस्कृति में शक्ति, क्रियाशीलता और सजगता के प्रतीक के रूप में देखा जाता है।

in_pashto.name: عاصفه
in_pashto.meaning: عاصفه د هغې ښځې نوم دی چې خپل کارونه يې د ډېر جدت او فعاليت سره پرمخ وړي
in_pashto.long_meaning: عاصفه نوم د عربي کلمې 'ع-ص-ف' څخه مشتق شوی دی، چې د چټکۍ يا فعاليت مانا لري. په پښتو کې، عاصفه د هغې ښځې نوم دی چې خپل کارونه يې د ډېر جدت، فعاليت اومنظم ډول سره پرمخ وړي. دا نوم د عربي کلتور کې د ځواک، فعاليت او جدت د نښه په توګه کارول کېږي.

in_english.name: Asifa
in_english.meaning: Asifa means a woman who manages her affairs with diligence and activity
in_english.long_meaning: The name Asifa is derived from the Arabic root 'ع-ص-ف' (ʿ-ṣ-f), which means speed or activity. In Islamic tradition, Asifa refers to a woman who handles her life's matters with great diligence, energy, and seriousness. The name may also relate to the natural phenomenon of a storm, suggesting strength and dynamism. Historically, the name Asifa has been used across various Muslim cultures, symbolizing a proactive and determined personality.

pronunciation.urdu: اردو میں تلفظ کی تفصیل: عاصفہ
pronunciation.pashto: په پښتو کې د تلفظ تفصیل: عاصفه

data.cultural_impact: The name Asifa carries a rich cultural heritage in Islamic communities. It is often associated with strength, resilience, and protection, as it signifies one who is safeguarded by Allah. This can be a source of comfort and pride for parents who bestow this name upon their child, and it can serve as a reminder of Allah's presence and care in their daily lives.
data.spiritual_significance: On a deeper level, the name Asifa holds a profound spiritual significance. It serves as a constant reminder that no matter the challenges or hardships one may face, Allah is always there to shield and protect them. It also encourages a sense of surrender and trust in Allah's provision and care, inspiring individuals to rely on Him and seek refuge in His boundless mercy and wisdom. Overall, the name Asifa offers a powerful connection to Allah and a reminder of His unwavering love and protection.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Protected" symbolizes One who is protected by Allah. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Asifa serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of protected.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Asifa is mentioned in the Hadith as a companion of the Prophet Muhammad. The name Asifa carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Asifa was a female companion who played a significant role in the early Islamic community.

trends: increasing popularity in the Middle East and South Asia
modern_usage.modern_context: The name Asifa remains relevant in modern Muslim society, representing a bridge between traditional Islamic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Islamic names.
